name: Merchant
description: A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain.

abilities.name: Preferential Treatment
abilities.description: A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a Presence Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has disadvantage on future Presence Rolls against the Merchant.

abilities.name: The Runaround
abilities.description: When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a Presence Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a Stress.
